name: Execution recovery
description: Submit a controlled test-owned operation through the real Agents UI, observe its execution, recover from a controlled failure, and verify the terminal state with backend evidence.

steps.goal: From FreeInference staging, open the Agents application and find test agent execution

intervention.requiredAction: Complete Agents authentication in the attached browser tab.

steps.goal: Create a test-owned agent with a unique test name and verify it appears in the correct application state
Submit a controlled operation to the test-owned agent and capture the identifiable execution ID
